notes: The volume chart now draws a line for each muscle group across your weeks, so every group's trend is on one screen.
A missed week is easy to spot — its column is shaded and every line sits at zero. No scolding, just the shape of your training.
A colour key under the chart names all seven groups.
It still switches between sets, tonnage and reps — and it now tells you which groups have rested longest, so you know a good place to start.
